safety_checks.name: Deterministic Policy Guardrails
safety_checks.detail: Enforces 5,000 INR fare delta ceiling, 3-hour delay cap, and 45-min minimum buffers.

safety_checks.name: Prompt Injection Isolation
safety_checks.detail: Quarantines untrusted passenger/airline notices in isolated tags, preventing instruction overrides.

safety_checks.name: Candidate Whitelist Validation
safety_checks.detail: Rejects any proposed flight ID not present in validated sandbox inventory, preventing hallucinations.

safety_checks.name: Daily Budget & Rate Circuit Breakers
safety_checks.detail: Enforces 80% daily model call cap with safe 0-token deterministic fallback.

safety_checks.name: Explanation Fact Verification
safety_checks.detail: Validates flight numbers, dates, and fare deltas in generated explanations against structured records.

safety_checks.name: Multi-Entity Atomicity
safety_checks.detail: Coordinates flight rebooking and linked hotel check-in date shifts in a single unified decision pipeline.
